hub.releaseNotes: First public release — your restaurant's own server. Orders keep flowing with no internet and everything syncs to the cloud when the connection returns. Pair it from the Devices screen.

spot.releaseNotes: First public release — one app for every device in the restaurant: self-order kiosk, table tablet, waiter phone, kitchen screen and TV board. Finds your Ordrili Hub automatically on the restaurant Wi-Fi.
